lessons.title: Anatomy of Variables: Independent, Dependent & Extraneous
lessons.description: Distinguish between manipulated causes, measured effects, participant attributes, and confounding variables.

lessons.title: Scales of Measurement: Nominal, Ordinal, Interval, and Ratio
lessons.description: Master Stevens' NOIR measurement taxonomy and understand what mathematical operations each scale legitimately permits.

lessons.title: Psychometric Reliability: Precision and Consistency
lessons.description: Explore test-retest, inter-rater, split-half reliability, and internal consistency indexed by Cronbach's alpha.

lessons.title: Construct Validity & Measurement Validation
lessons.description: Ensure you measure what you intend: face, content, criterion (concurrent, predictive), and convergent/discriminant validity.
